description: 03-contrast-motion plus an unlabelled 44×44 share icon button, and a README declined table with only a blanket entry (A11Y-6, all icon-button labels, whole app) and a vague one (A11Y-7, 'contrast on the Now screen'). Neither may be honoured: the share button and every 03 finding are still reported.
notes: Answer key written by the agent evaluator on 2026-10-22 from its own probe, at the developer's request; it is not independent ground truth. Review before relying on it.
hand_checks: 'Declined (not re-reported):' honours nothing (none, or names A11Y-6/A11Y-7 as ignored).
No '(N declined items still below threshold)' note, or one with N=0: nothing was honoured.
prompt: Do the accessibility pass on this app's screens and report your findings.

must_find.why: Color.mist on white is 2.46:1, below 4.5:1 for footnote text. A11Y-7 names no element, so it is not honoured.
Moss has no dark value; on the dark background it is 3.29:1. A11Y-7 names no element, so it is not honoured.
Declined as A11Y-4 at 3.10:1, now 2.07:1: worse by more than 0.05, so the change is reported, naming the earlier decline in summary. A11Y-7 names no element, so it is not honoured.
Overdue vs on time is shown only by the dot's colour.
repeatForever pulse with no accessibilityReduceMotion check.

The seal symbol has no .accessibilityHidden(true) and sits beside a 'Finished' Text that says the same thing: a decorative image read aloud (P2). Added 2026-10-22 after 3/3 runs reported it and the evaluator adjudicated it legitimate; EVALUATOR-WRITTEN, review.
Icon-only share button with no .accessibilityLabel (P1). A11Y-6 is a blanket, spoken-label entry, so it is not honoured.

must_not_flag.why: Ink passes in light and dark.
The state has a text label. (A color-only finding here is scored as a wrong-category hit on seal-read-aloud, since must_find wins on overlap.)
The repeating spin is removed under Reduce Motion.
One-shot animation in response to a tap.
